messages:
hiro: heads-up: spinning up calyx-v1-int4 canary (eu-west-1). quick smoke: monolingual en/ja ok, but mixed CJK + arabic fragments produce unexpected spaces and bracket mirroring during detok. BLEU drop ~3.8 pts vs float baseline on our locale-mix devset.

anika: ugh. can you share a tiny repro and the exact tokenizer bundle?

hiro: reproducer below. model bundle built from ci 2026-03-02, tokenizer wheel v2026-03-05 (we did upgrade sentencepiece last week).
```bash
python run_eval.py --model calyx-v1-int4 --dataset locale-mix-small --subset bracketing --output smoke.json
```
input: "\u65e5\u672c[\u0627\u0644\u0639\u0631\u0628\u064a] end"
expected detok: "\u65e5\u672c[\u0627\u0644\u0639\u0631\u0628\u064a] end"
actual detok: "\u65e5\u672c[ \u0627\u0644\u0639\u0631\u0628\u064a ] end"  <-- extra space tokens next to brackets and bracket visually mirrored to RTL side
metrics: float BLEU 29.7 -> int4 25.9, token_count float 7 -> int4 9

marc: could be detokenizer bidi reflow happening after token-level whitespace insertion. Another angle: embedding lookup aliasing after quant pack.

hiro: dumped ids:
float: [56, 2340, 11, 889, 203, 77]
int4:  [56, 2340, 11, 4002, 889, 203, 77]  # id 4002 corresponds to a space-ish token in runtime vocab

eval-bot: automated summary for 1763809876: BLEU_delta=-3.8, token_delta=+2, affected_pairs=[ja-ar, zh-ar]. See /internal/evals/1763809876 for logs. :warning:

natalia: next steps: (1) verify tokenizer artifact inside quant bundle matches runtime wheel (hashes), (2) run two-stage quant bisect: quantize weights-only then embeddings, (3) run detok with bidi-log-mode to see cluster ops, (4) try older sentencepiece wheel (2026-02-28) to rule out compiler flags.

anika: I'll queue bisect jobs and a quick baseline run with the older wheel. tagging infra to keep canary traffic low for locales with arabic.

hiro: queued small repro harness that prints grapheme clusters and token spans. linking artifact in gist: https://internal.gists/1763809876/repro.txt

marc: FYI we've seen similar bracket adjacency issues when ZWJ/ZWNJ are split into separate tokens after quant pack. Might be exacerbated by our detok heuristics that reflow based on script runs.

natalia: good to add a preflight check: fail canary promotion if any locale-mix BLEU delta > 2.0 or token_count increased by >1 for bracket-heavy inputs.

anika: jobs started: bisect-w-only job 7101, bisect-emb job 7102. will post artifacts when done.

hiro: will hold promotion and update docs on the rollout board. thanks all. :handshake:
